mechanism_interpretation: The proposed semantic address prior and request-focused Q refinement did not deliver the claimed combined generation benefit in this trained model. early_paired_visual_evidence.observation: Disabling the whole physical operator eliminates the full-frame vertical stripes and restores recognizable mop displacement and water-pattern changes. Mop shape and water traces are still imperfect; this is not a claim of completely correct execution.
early_paired_visual_evidence.causal_conclusion: For this checkpoint and paired example, the active physical injection causes the catastrophic visual degradation. This does not yet assign blame among request refinement, semantic support and learned physical Q, nor establish the result of retraining without those components.

latest_control_interpretation: On the fixed16, bypassing the physical operator raises SA from2.75 to3.25 and Joint from2 to6, while PC drops from3.875 to3.625. Together with VP010 matched videos, this establishes an adverse online fusion effect in this checkpoint; attribution to subcomponents awaits their interventions.

paired_visual_no_c_additional.VP027: No_c restores hand repositioning and dough manipulation; normal injection holds nearly the initial arrangement. Both can receive high scores, so nominal pass does not establish execution quality.
paired_visual_no_c_additional.VP034: No_c removes the stripe collapse and preserves a recognizable balloon with position/size changes, but clear sustained inflation is not established and the tied end changes irregularly.
paired_visual_no_c_additional.VP038: No_c restores large roller movement and a painted region, but has severe roller/handle deformation. Normal injection largely holds the starting image. Neither is a fully satisfactory generation.

quality_interpretation: Higher PC under normal injection is not automatically a beneficial physical correction: on the inspected cases it coexists with catastrophic texture collapse or avoidance of requested evolution. Disabling injection recovers some processes but still has physical/shape errors and fails the PC target. The redesign must improve process execution and physical integrity together.

paired_visual_semantic_routing_off.VP010: Removing only semantic routing eliminates full-frame stripes and restores a recognizable moving mop. Water removal remains incomplete; other physical components and independent physical Q are retained.
paired_visual_semantic_routing_off.VP034: Removing only semantic routing eliminates stripes and restores a recognizable balloon. Sustained inflation is still weak or absent in the sampled frames.
paired_visual_semantic_routing_off.conclusion: The new semantic support prior has a direct harmful online effect in these two paired cases. Keeping the learned physical Q while removing the prior is sufficient to remove catastrophic texture collapse. This localizes the failure more narrowly than full no_c, but does not establish aggregate scores or successful process execution.

posthoc_score_improvement_review.selection: VP008 improved SA versus R10A; VP021 improved SA versus R1. Chosen after scores to examine apparent successes, explicitly not predeclared.

VP008.observation: R1 shows changes in trampoline pose/position with later body deformation; R10A is nearly static. R15E collapses into repeated vertical stripes after the initial frame despite gaining nominal Joint versus R10A.

VP021.observation: R1 and R10A retain a recognizable skateboarder, with R10A showing road displacement. R15E becomes repeated vertical stripes despite SA5/PC5. This nominal best-scoring output is a severe generation failure.

posthoc_score_improvement_review.conclusion: The inspected apparent numeric gains do not establish real improvements. Even joint passing of SA and PC can miss catastrophic visual failure here. Preserve official-protocol raw scores but reject the model on actual-video grounds; all numeric targets and visual/cross-benchmark quality remain required together.
